gold: Short-coupled polymorphic ventricular tachycardia/ventricular fibrillation (SC-PMVT/VF) variant of idiopathic ventricular fibrillation

selector.why: The presence of polymorphic ventricular tachycardia and ventricular fibrillation, along with the normal QT intervals and the specific morphology of the premature ventricular complexes, points towards Catecholaminergic Polymorphic Ventricular Tachycardia, especially given the lack of clear evidence against it and the presence of a variant of unknown significance in the RyR2 gene.
